description: This file defines the `SearchQueryContributor` interface, which allows setting and retrieving the final predicate used in search queries within the OpenMRS Hibernate search module. It facilitates the customization of search filters by external components.

classes.name: SearchQueryContributor
classes.description: Interface to set and get the final search predicate, enabling modification of search queries, such as applying filters.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Sets the final predicate for a search query, allowing customization or filtering of search results.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set final predicate for the search query.
